text: Level three, question six: a man walks to work at five kilometres per hour and returns at three kilometres per hour; the round trip takes two hours forty minutes; how far is his workplace? Question seven: a car covers a distance in six hours at fifty kilometres per hour; at what speed must it travel to cover the same distance in five hours? Question eight: two trains start at the same time and run for the same time at fifty-four and seventy-two kilometres per hour; the faster one covers thirty-six kilometres more; how long did they run, and how far did each go?
